findings.root_cause: YARA rule enforces `$svg at 0 or $svg in (0..1024)`. Prepending comments >1 KB pushes the root element outside the scan window.
findings.policy_recommendation: REC-YARA-001: Expand root search window to 4,096 bytes or complement with structural XML parser.
